source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 263 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 263 was established by Ordinance No. 19465, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 11, 1987. Ordinance No. 19465 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 263 is established on property generally located along the south line of Ledbetter Drive, west of the west line of Duncanville Road. The size of PD 263 is approximately 8.0 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the approved development plan (Exhibit 263A). (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.105. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the city plan commission-approved landscape plan (Exhibit 263B). Landscaping must be installed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.106. PERMITTED USES.

The only permitted uses on the Property are those uses permitted in a Mobile Home District, as indicated in Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.107. SETBACKS.

All buildings and structures, including but not limited to carports, garages, storage buildings, offices, caretaker’s dwellings, laundry houses, recreational vehicles, and mobile homes, must be setback as follows:

(1) A minimum of 10 feet from the western and southern boundaries of the Property.

(2) A minimum of 50 feet from the eastern boundary of the Property.

(3) A minimum of 20 feet from the southern right-of-way line of Ledbetter Drive. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.108. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted lot coverage is 20 percent for residential structures and 25 percent for nonresidential structures. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.109. MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHT.

No structure on the Property may exceed a height of 24 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.110. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking on the Property must be provided at the ratio of 1.5 spaces for each transient stand constructed. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.111. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Open Space
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.112. OPEN SPACE.

Open space must be provided at a ratio of 500 square feet of open space for each of the first 20 transient stands and at a ratio of 250 square feet of open space for each additional transient stand. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.113. SCREENING.

A six-foot-high solid screening wall or fence must be provided and maintained along the southern and eastern boundaries of the Property, as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.114. MAINTENANCE.

The entire premises must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.116. PAVING.

(a) All streets, driveways, parking spaces, and maneuvering areas for parking must be constructed to meet the requirements of Chapter 51.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-263.118. ZONING MAP.

PD 263 is located on Zoning Map Nos. N-4 and O-4. (Ord. Nos. 19465; 25711)
